proposals.before: In the second year of Qingtai, spring, first month, on the bingchen day, the first of the month, the Emperor presided in the Hall of Bright Clarity to receive court congratulations, with guards and honors as prescribed.
proposals.after: In the second year of Qingtai, spring, first month, on the bingshen day, the first of the month, the Emperor presided in the Hall of Bright Clarity to receive court congratulations, with guards and honors as prescribed.
proposals.reason: Chinese 丙申 is bingshen; bingchen would be 丙辰.

proposals.before: On gengshen, the Eastern Capital presented Heavenly King armor.
proposals.after: On gengshen, the capital at Ye presented Heavenly King armor.
proposals.reason: 鄴都 is Ye, not the Eastern Capital (東京).

proposals.before: While the Emperor was still in the provinces, a physiognomancer said he resembled the Guardian King Vaisravana; knowing this, he was quietly pleased.
proposals.after: While the Emperor was still a prince in his fief, a physiognomancer said he resembled the Guardian King Vaisravana; knowing this, he was quietly pleased.
proposals.reason: 在藩 means his period as a regional prince, not merely being in the provinces.

proposals.before: On xinchou Zhao Yanshou, former Bianzhou commander, was made Xuzhou commander and concurrent Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner;
proposals.after: On xinchou Zhao Yanshou, former Bianzhou commander, was made Xu Prefecture commander and concurrent Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner;
proposals.reason: Xu Prefecture (许州/許州) is not Xuzhou (徐州); the idiomatic line conflates two different prefectures.

proposals.before: On bingwu, Zhao Guangfu, Supervising Secretary, was made Right Regular Attendant of the Imperial Stud.
proposals.after: On bingwu, Zhao Guangfu, Supervising Secretary, was made Right Cavalier Attendant.

proposals.after: Chief Counselor Lu Wenji was made concurrent Commissioner of the Supreme Palace; Yao Yan, Grand Academician of the Hongwen Institute, was advanced to Vice Director of the Chancellery; Zhang Yanlang, overseer of the National History, was made concurrent Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

proposals.after: Han Zhaoyi, Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of War and Counselor.

proposals.before: In autumn, the seventh month, on bingshen Shi Jingtang reported that he had executed Li Hui and thirty-five other horse-guard commanders for plotting rebellion.

proposals.before: An edict stated: "You are talents who aid the age and great virtues who stabilize the times—some who helped establish the realm at the founding, some who governed at the succession; your roles as chief ministers are equally honored, and your remonstrance equally earnest; we request restoring the Yanying system to extend the norms of deliberating on government.
proposals.after: An edict stated: "You are talents who aid the age and great virtues who stabilize the times—some who helped establish the realm at the founding, some who governed at the succession; your roles as chief ministers are equally honored, and your remonstrance equally earnest; the Yanying system is to be restored to extend the norms of deliberating on government.
proposals.reason: The edict (詔) grants the ministers' request; 請復 here is not the emperor himself petitioning. Idiomatic 'we request restoring' reverses the illocution of an imperial rescript.
